class="Le88gL comp-m4orjlmq5 wixui-section" data-block-level-container="ClassicSection"><div id="bgLayers_comp-m4orjlmq5" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-m4orjlmq5" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-m4orjlmq5" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-m4orjlmq5" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-m4orjlmq5inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-m4orjlmq5inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-m4orjlmr" class="UwkEpO _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m4orjlmr wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:56px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:56px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Oman</span></span></h1></div><div id="comp-m4orjlmr7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m4orjlmr7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;">18-26&nbsp; July</p></div><div id="comp-m4orjlms1" class="UwkEpO _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m4orjlms1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;">Beautifull, pristine and windy paradise. That&rsquo;s the best way to describe Oman.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
The variety of kite spots and stunning Waddys. Oman is one of the best kitesurfing spots in the world, yet still not crowded and very untouched. Summer time is the best kitesurfing season. It&rsquo;s a monsoon time so in the kite spots temperature is around 27 degrees and water is pleasantly warm. Oman trip is an adventure so don&rsquo;t expect big luxury resorts just get ready to explore and connect with nature.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjln01" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Spot and Wind Conditions</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1#planofthetrip" target="_self" data-anchor-comp-id="comp-m5r1j1ll" data-anchor="dataItem-m5r1j1tr" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Plan of the Trip</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjlnf9" class="wixui-rich-text__text">What is included</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjln98" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Price</span></a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p></div></div></div></section><section id="comp-m4orjlms9" tabindex="-1" class="Le88gL comp-m4orjlms9 wixui-section" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-m5r1j1ll" class="qe3oTb ignore-focus comp-m5r1j1ll" role="region" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Plan of the Trip"><div id="planofthetrip"></div><span class="TvbeET">Plan of the Trip</span></div><section id="comp-m4orjln04" class="comp-m4orjln04 CeUMmm wixui-column-strip"><div id="bgLayers_comp-m4orjln04" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-m4orjln04" class="ktMZav"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="V9k0ll etGVsi"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-m4orjln04" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-m4orjln04" class="etSQ9j"></div></div><div data-testid="columns" class="Ak0vpt"><div id="comp-m4orjln32" class="comp-m4orjln32 FDI5TK wixui-column-strip__column"><div id="bgLayers_comp-m4orjln32" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-m4orjln32" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-m4orjln32" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-m4orjln32" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-m4orjln32inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-m4orjln32inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-m4orjln39" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m4orjln39 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h5 class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:24px;"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Spot and wind conditions​</span></span></h5>
<h5 class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></h5>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">The main season is between June-August. Wind speed is usually from 18-30 knots. The main kitesurfing spots are Masirah Island where there is variety of kite spots, both flat and waves.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Bar al Hikman completely remote place on the main land, with stunning lagoon, white and soft sand. On the others side of the lagoon there is an open sea with small waves.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Plan of the Trip</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">8 nights /9 days exploration road trip around the best kitesurfing spots in Oman.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>
<ul class="color_36 font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Arrival to Muscat Airport 18th or night 17th (in this case extra night is required in the hotel close to the airport, I have recommended hotel for You where you can recharge before we start the trip on the 18th)</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">I recommend a flight which will arrive a day earlier before our departure on the 18th. First stop will be Ras al Had Lagoon which is 3h drive from Muscat. we will have a warm up session there, and spend night in Ras Al Hadd.&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Optionally we can make an evening/ night excursion with local guides to see turtle eggs laying&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Departure by ferry to Masirah Island first thing in the morning on the 19th</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;We leave bags in the hotel and drive directly to the kite spot</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">4 nights in Masirah island, where we will be exploring different kite spots&nbsp;</span><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">7:30 Morning Yoga Class</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">8:30/9:00 Breakfast in the local restaurant</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">10:00 departing to the kite spot.&nbsp;</span><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">The closest kite spot is around 35 minutes from the village.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">11:00 kite coaching lesson with video analysis in the small groups</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">After 4 nights in Masirah we grab ferry back to the main land&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Off road drive to the very remote spot called Bar al Hikman.&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">We stay at the camp in Bar al Hikman to connect with a nature and enjoy flat lagoon and open sea on the other side.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">In bar al Hikman we follow same daily schedule as in Masirah&nbsp;</span><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">(Yoga, breakfast, kite coaching)</span><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Morning check out and drive back to the airport.&nbsp;</span><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">It&rsquo;s around 4.5 hours&rsquo; drive from Bar al hikman to Muscat.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Depending on the time of your flight back you might consider taking an extra room in the hotel close to Muscat to get refreshed before the flight back.</span></p>
</li>
